_meta.description: SUPERSEDED by the 2026-07 IA revision: the Service top-level entry and its ServiceHubOverview hub page are dropped. The former service leaves (Requests→Tickets, Tasks, Contactmomenten, Complaints, Projects, MyWork) now live under Customer Support (KccWerkplek) and the booking domain moves under Operational: see src/menu-layout.json#relocations. This fragment is intentionally left empty rather than deleted to preserve the ADR-037 fragment slot; the leaf page routes remain registered by their own fragments/manifest.
